site_name: Keelers Service Centre, 707 Harrow Road, Wembley, HA0 2LL
description: Details pursuant to conditions 9b (verification report), 13 (landscaping) ,14 (satellite dishes) and 15(sound insulation) of Variation of Conditions reference 24/2828 dated 12 August, 2025, for Variation of condition 2, development built in accordance with approved drawings to allow:Amendments to the internal layout including an increased size basement with an additional staircase;Amendments to the proposed unit mix including an additional dwelling located on the 5th floor;Relocation of and increased quantum of cycle storage provision;Amendments to the overall quantum and provision of private external amenity space;Amendments to the elevational treatment including additional canopies at ground floor level and revised window details and balcony rails;Removal of rooftop PV panels and sedum roof and the installation of 4x Air Source Heat Pumps; and,Amendments to the layout of the public realm;of Full Planning Permission reference 18/3069 (as amended by 24/0313) (revised description) for Demolition of existing M.O.T testing centre and erection of a part 5 and part 6 storey mixed use building comprising office (Use class B1) at ground floor, residential units on the 1st to 5th floors, plant room in basement; PV panels at roof level, cycle parking and waste storage (revised description), subject to Deed of Agreement dated 10 February 2020 and a Deed of Variation dated 5th August 2025 under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.
